Gene analysis and LFC cutoff selection & ShinyGO output.

# Settings

```{r}
input_file <- "data/processed/deseq2_output_Colon_Sigmoid_vs_Whole_Blood.rds"

bands <- list(c(1.5, 4)) # |log2FC| ranges to export, each c(min, max). Inf = no upper limit
base_mean_min <- 100 # mean normalized count across all samples must be at least this. 0 = off

out_dir <- "results/shinygo/input"
```

```{r}
inp <- readRDS(input_file)
res <- inp$res
s <- inp$settings

names(bands) <- sapply(bands, function(b) paste0("lfc", b[1], "-", b[2]))
```

# Bands

```{r}
sig <- !is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < s$alpha
expressed <- res$baseMean >= base_mean_min

hist(res$log2FoldChange[sig], breaks = 100, main = NULL, xlab = paste("Log2 FC", s$comparison))
abline(v = c(-unlist(bands), unlist(bands)), col = "red")

# Significant genes in each band, before and after the base mean filter
sapply(bands, function(b) {
  in_band <- sig & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > b[1] & abs(res$log2FoldChange) < b[2]
  c(in_band = sum(in_band), expressed = sum(in_band & expressed))
})
```

# Reference gene sets

- Housekeeping: [HRT Atlas, Hounkpe et al. 2021](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7778946/)
- Mitochondrial: [MitoCarta3.0](https://www.broadinstitute.org/mitocarta/mitocarta30-inventory-mammalian-mitochondrial-proteins-and-pathways)
- Autophagy: [Bordi et al. 2021](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8563709/).
- Autophagy induction: Also included in Bordi. Only 6 genes.
- Brain enriched: [Human Protein Atlas](https://www.proteinatlas.org/humanproteome/tissue/tissue+specific)
- Metabolism: [Reactome](https://reactome.org/content/detail/R-HSA-1430728)

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(readxl)
hk <- unique(read.csv2("data/raw/Housekeeping_GenesHuman.csv")$Gene.name)
mito <- read_excel("data/raw/Human.MitoCarta3.0.xls", sheet = "A Human MitoCarta3.0")$Symbol
f <- "data/raw/autophagy_Bordi2021_MOESM1.xlsx"
autophagy <- unlist(lapply(excel_sheets(f), function(sh) read_excel(f, sheet = sh, col_names = FALSE)[[1]])) # first column of every sheet; non-gene rows won't match a symbol
autophagy_induction <- c("ATG14", "ATG7", "NBR1", "ULK1", "ULK2", "WDR45")
# brain <- read.delim("data/raw/HPA_brain_tissue_enriched.tsv")$Gene
reactome <- strsplit(readLines("data/raw/ReactomePathways.gmt"), "\t") # one line per pathway: name, ID, then its genes
names(reactome) <- sapply(reactome, `[`, 1)
metabolism <- reactome[["Metabolism"]][-(1:2)]

sets <- list(All = res$symbol, Housekeeping = hk, Mitochondrial = mito, Autophagy = autophagy, Autophagy_induction = autophagy_induction, Metabolism = metabolism) # removed Brain = brain,
lfc <- lapply(sets, function(g) abs(res$log2FoldChange[res$symbol %in% g]))

par(mar = c(9, 4, 3, 1)) # room for the set names and the title
boxplot(lfc, outline = FALSE, ylab = "|Log2 FC|", main = s$comparison, las = 2, cex.axis = 0.8) # las = 2 turns the names sideways so none are dropped
abline(h = unlist(bands), col = "red")

# Share of each set inside each band
round(sapply(lfc, function(x) c(n = length(x), median = median(x), sapply(bands, function(b) mean(x > b[1] & x < b[2])))), 2)
```

# Gene lists for ShinyGO

For each band: genes higher in the target, genes higher in the reference, and both directions together ("both" = -max to +max). Plus the background (every tested gene that passes the base mean filter). Ensembl IDs with the version suffix stripped ("ENSG00000302013.1" -\> "ENSG00000302013"), one per line, ready to paste into ShinyGO.

```{r}
strip_version <- function(x) unique(sub("\\..*$", "", x))

bm_tag <- paste0("bm", base_mean_min)

gene_lists <- list()
gene_lists[[paste0(bm_tag, "_background")]] <- strip_version(res$gene_id[expressed])
for (b in names(bands)) {
  in_band <- sig & expressed & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > bands[[b]][1] & abs(res$log2FoldChange) < bands[[b]][2]
  gene_lists[[paste0(b, "_", bm_tag, "_up_in_", s$target)]] <- strip_version(res$gene_id[in_band & res$log2FoldChange > 0]) # higher in target
  gene_lists[[paste0(b, "_", bm_tag, "_up_in_", s$ref)]] <- strip_version(res$gene_id[in_band & res$log2FoldChange < 0]) # higher in reference
  gene_lists[[paste0(b, "_", bm_tag, "_both")]] <- strip_version(res$gene_id[in_band]) # either direction
}

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
for (n in names(gene_lists)) {
  writeLines(gene_lists[[n]], file.path(out_dir, paste0("shinygo_", s$file_tag, "_", n, ".txt")))
}
lengths(gene_lists)
```
